headline: Windows 11 November update fixes bugs, hits installation issues
summary: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday update for Windows 11 fixed over a thousand security flaws, added a customizable right-click menu, and resolved USB audio problems from September's updates. Some users then reported installation failures with specific error codes on systems running October's preview update; Microsoft confirmed the issue and said a fix was underway.

claims.statement: Microsoft released the November 2026 Patch Tuesday cumulative updates (KB5132061 and KB5131087) for Windows 11.

sources.quote: Windows 11 KB5132061 & KB5131087 cumulative updates released

claims.statement: The update fixes a large number of security vulnerabilities, including an actively exploited flaw.
The update adds a customizable right-click File Explorer menu.

sources.quote: you can finally customize your right-click menu in Windows 11

claims.statement: The update fixes USB audio issues that had affected Windows systems since September's updates.

sources.quote: Microsoft fixes audio issues caused by September security updates
resolve USB audio issues plaguing Windows users who have installed security updates released since September

claims.statement: Some users reported the update failing to install, with specific error codes.

sources.quote: KB5132061 throws 0x800F0993 and 0x800F0989 errors, and Redmond is saying nothing
Microsoft confirms Windows security updates installation issues

claims.statement: Microsoft confirmed the installation failures affect systems running the October preview update.

sources.quote: Microsoft has confirmed reports that the November 2026 security updates are failing to install on Windows 11 systems with the October preview update.
This month’s security update is failing on some systems already running the preview update released in October.

claims.statement: A fix for the installation failures was reported to be underway.

sources.quote: But there is a fix afoot.
